correction: A list sorted by start cannot be split in two at the first unfinished item: a long event under way starts before shorter ones that are over. Judge each occurrence by its own end, then order each group.
evidence: TestSearchRowsJudgeEachOccurrenceByItsEnd (desktop) and calendarSearch.test.ts's "judges each occurrence by its own end" (web) put an ongoing five-day conference under Upcoming and the finished meetings that start after it under Earlier; both fail on the split at the first unfinished one.
